thread:
anya - PM: Quick thread  deciding pilot consent matrix + minimal ROI thresholds for Optimize recommendations (batching/caching/quant). Need simple rules for legal/ops.

sam - Eng: TL;DR: set a measurable ROI floor and a telemetry budget. If pilot doesn't hit ROI within 7 days, auto-pause recommendations.

li - ML: Concordance metric idea: weighted F1 over customer's canonical prompts combined with semantic similarity > 0.92. Suggest ROI floor = 5% token savings or 3% latency improvement, whichever is larger.

maria - Solutions: Customers expect explicit consent for content-altering optimizations. For regulated verticals (healthcare/finance) default must be opt-in.

ux - Design: We'll add an explainer pill in the console: why recommended + one-click revert. Keep copy under 30 words.

devops-bot: deploy 1725000020 started -> canary to optimize-pilot

sam - Eng: Telemetry budget proposal: sample 10% of requests for full traces, aggregate hourly. Per-recommendation detailed logs retained 72h then roll up.

li - ML: Safety gate: if semantic similarity < 0.90 OR concordance drops > 2% sustained for 4h, automatically pause and notify the tenant.

maria - Solutions: Pilot consent matrix draft: healthcare = explicit opt-in; SMB SaaS = opt-out with 7-day notice; enterprise = contractual clause + dedicated contact.

anya - PM: ROI gating logic: rolling 24h ROI = (token_baseline - token_opt)/token_baseline. Require >= 5% sustained for 48h and no SLO breaches to graduate.

sam - Eng: Implementation notes: per-tenant feature flags + simple rule engine to evaluate gates. Emit audit events for every automated decision.

ux - Design: We'll include a tooltip for "concordance" and a short example showing what a 1% drop looks like in practice.

maria - Solutions: I'll draft pilot consent emails, a short FAQ, and collect customer KPIs for the A/B harness.

anya - PM: Action owners & dates: maria consent drafts by Tue, sam feature-flag + sampling by Thu, li metric defs + alerts by Thu, ux microcopy by Wed. Reconvene next Tue 10:00 to review.

sam - Eng: Risk: GPU validation backlog for quant variants. Mitigation: start with int8 + conservative batching heuristics.

li - ML: Add auto-rollback watermark: if downstream KPI (customer-defined) drops > 3% vs baseline, immediate rollback and create incident.

anya - PM: Thanks all. Keep the playbook minimal; we'll iterate based on pilot feedback. :white_check_mark:
